detail.longDescription:
Anytype is a private, offline-first workspace for notes, docs, tasks, and team collaboration — end-to-end encrypted, with your data stored on your device. No accounts mining your thoughts, no cloud lock-in. A safe haven for your digital life.

Flexible Knowledge
Anytype adapts to the way your brain works, allowing you to link anything to everything. Create a living map of your ideas.
• Capture & Reflect: Rich-media notes, long-form docs, and daily journals.
• Plan & Execute: Tasks and projects in Kanban boards, calendars, galleries, and filtered lists.
• Organize & Archive: Build personal wikis, research databases, or curated bookmark libraries.

Secure Collaboration
Collaborate in real-time without surrendering your privacy. You can work offline, sync peer-to-peer, or run entirely on your own network.
• Private Collaboration: Shared spaces for teams and family to work together.
• Integrated Chat: Chat with friends or have discussions directly on documents.
• Share Online: Web publish content so others can access it directly in the browser.

Uncompromising Security & Privacy
• End-to-End Encrypted: Only you and those you share with can access your data. No exceptions.
• Works Offline: No internet? No problem. Access everything offline, use peer-to-peer sync, or run on your own network.
• Open Source: Keep your software forever or take your data with you. Zero lock-in.

Also available on desktop at anytype.io

Anytype — a safe haven for your thoughts, your work, and the people you collaborate with.
